The m94, m95, and m166 outcomes continue to show endpoint-specific tails, while neutral controls such as 571dc7d7b903eed7cdf6 were close; consequently, most selections target measured failure regions and use local matched controls within those families.","batch_rationale":"The batch contains six m72 measurements to resolve the strongest repeated donor-rich failure, three m204 ratio points, four m212 amine points, and five basic heteroaromatic points. These local curves repair extrapolation and discriminate ratio effects from loading context. Four m94 and two m166 measurements focus on V2-tail transfer, while m120 and m135 points test whether donor-rich anomalies generalize across aromatic alcohol scaffolds. The two m160 and one m86 selections add loading contrasts in high-retention aminoaromatic and amino-ester regions. Together, the batch samples both endpoints, includes matched contrasts rather than only extreme predictions, and should improve generalization across the Row-distribution by teaching condition interactions in chemically coherent failure regions while limiting universal overcorrection."}
